newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs firm but off day's high after industrial data.
newsitem.headline: JGBs firm but off day's high after industrial data.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures were firm in afternoon Tokyo after edging up still further on Japanese industrial production data released at 0430 GMT, traders said.

The figures showed April industrial output down a revised 0.5 percent month-on-month, compared with preliminary estimates of a 0.4 percent fall. On a year-on-year basis, industrial production rose a revised 4.8 percent against estimates of a 4.9 percent increase.
Key September stood at 124.18 against 123.85 at Friday's close, with volume of 22,030 contracts traded.
September rose briefly as high as 124.20 before falling back.

But the overall impact was limited, with operators still wary about when and where sales were likely to emerge. A key resistance point is at 124.37 and many expect the topside to be capped near 124.50, traders said.
Strength in cash bonds, and overall positive sentiment in the wake of strong gains in overseas Friday trade, also helped futures rise.
Yield on the benchmark 10-year 182nd cash bond was at 2.355 percent against 2.390 percent at Friday's close.
